name: Keren

routes.outcome: Official Eritrean Ministry of Information report states that the Ministry of Land, Water and Environment opened a cadastre office in Keren on 2012-07-19. It describes land-plot-based information, residential registration, master-plan/survey prerequisites, and Keren Municipal Administration facilitation. This evidences a local cadastre custodian, not a public parcel API.

Official Ministry of Information report identifies Eritrea's Mapping and Information Center and its land-survey role for development projects. It is a general national mapping route and was not treated as a Keren parcel registry or local public viewer.
